nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances; token balance ledger in OaxacaProtocol
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances; allowance ledger
mapping(address=>bool) public bacalar; privileged/whitelist flag toggled by owner and transfer logic
mapping(address=>bool) public cancun; flag driving allowance override to 4232
mapping(address=>bool) public antigua; blacklist-style flag causing require(false) in _transfer
mapping(address=>uint256) public chiapas; unused public mapping
bool private locas; one-shot flag controlling creator transfer branch
uint256 private _totalSupply; total token supply
uint256 private mexico; owner-settable transfer cap checked via require(amount < mexico)
uint256 private papas; large-amount threshold computed as chTx*30
uint256 private _trns; initial emission amount used in constructor Transfer event
uint256 private chTx; base chunk = _totalSupply/2100, used for papas and ActivateProtocol
uint8 private _decimals; token decimals (5)
string private _symbol; token symbol OAXACA
string private _name; token name Oaxaca Protocol
bool private chetumal; one-shot flag letting creator's first approve whitelist the spender
address private creator; deployer address granting privileged branches in _transfer/_approve
bool private palenque; protocol-active flag forcing require(false) for antigua senders
uint cabosanlucas = 0; nonce incremented inside randomly()
address private _owner / _ownr in Ownable; owner identity checked by onlyOwner
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for minting, ownership, transfers and entropy
block.timestamp (now), miner-influenced value used as randomness entropy in randomly()
OaxacaProtocol constructor; sets creator, supply, mexico, chTx, papas, flags and initial balance
SetStakingReward(uint256) external onlyOwner; overwrites mexico, the transfer cap
ActivateProtocol() external onlyOwner; sets mexico = chTx/2400 and palenque = true
transfer(address,uint256) external; delegates to _transfer with _msgSender()
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) external; calls _transfer then _approve to decrement allowance
approve(address,uint256) external; delegates to _approve
increasealowance(address,uint256) public; adds to allowance through _approve
decreaseallowance(address,uint256) public; subtracts from allowance through _approve
CreateAFarm(uint256) public onlyOwner; mints arbitrary amount to owner, uncapped inflation
CheckAPY(address,bool,bool,bool,bool) external onlyOwner; rewrites bacalar/cancun/antigua and palenque for any address
_transfer(address,address,uint256) internal; contains privileged creator branches, random cancun assignment, mexico cap and hidden require(false)
_mint(address,uint256) internal; increases _totalSupply and credits balance
_burn(address,uint256) internal; decreases balance and _totalSupply
_approve(address,address,uint256) internal; writes _allowances, may whitelist spender and override amount to 4232
_burnFrom(address,uint256) internal; burns then decrements allowance via _approve
randomly() internal; keccak256(now,msg.sender,cabosanlucas)%50 pseudo-randomness, increments nonce
onlyOwner modifier; requires _msgSender() == _owner || _ownr, the contract's sole access gate
getOwner() external view; returns owner()
totalSupply() external view; returns _totalSupply
balanceOf(address) external view; returns _balances[account]
allowance(address,address) external view; returns _allowances[owner][spender]
Predictable randomness: keccak256(block.timestamp, msg.sender, nonce) is miner/caller grindable
